budget_confirmed.description: Whether the account has confirmed it has budget

champion.description: Person inside the account who wants the deal to happen

close_date.description: When the deal is expected to close

competitor.description: Another vendor the account is considering or using

deal_value.description: Expected value of the deal, in the account's currency

decision_maker.description: Person who has to approve the deal

last_contacted.description: When the contact or account was last spoken to

next_step.description: What was agreed to happen next

note.description: A statement worth keeping that no other predicate fits, in the words it was stated

objection.description: A reason the account gave for not buying

pain_point.description: A problem the account wants solved
